en.t: Well, that is quite a lot.

units.source_text: 但不知眼前这些是不是能使小姐称心？”

en.t: But I do not know whether the ones here before you will please you, miss.

units.source_text: 植村说着站起身子，唤来了两个店员，耳语几句，

en.t: As Uemura said this, he stood up, called over two shop assistants, and whispered a few words to them,

units.source_text: 然后三个人搬出十几匹布料熟练地在店铺当中摊开让千重子看。

en.t: then the three of them brought out more than ten bolts of fabric and deftly spread them out in the shop for Chieko to see.
